topic: Rayleigh answered Luffy's question about strengthening Gear 4 with a warning about its cost, and Dressrosa chapter 786 showed what that cost was
title: Rayleigh's Gear 4 Warning Came True At Dressrosa
description: When Luffy asked how to make Gear 4 hit harder, Rayleigh gave him a warning instead of a technique. At Dressrosa, chapter 786, Luffy found out what he meant. Here is the cost most fans skip past.
comment: Was Gear 4's real weakness the exhaustion afterward, or the way it needs Armament Haki to work at all? Pick one.

lines.text: I think Rayleigh answered Luffy's Gear 4 question with a warning, not a technique.

shot.fallback: old man warning a boy gravely

lines.text: In the timeskip, Luffy builds Gear 4 and asks how to hit harder with it.

shot.fallback: inflated rubber boy with dark armor lines

lines.text: Rayleigh gives no move, only a warning about the consequences.

shot.fallback: serious old man and a worried boy

lines.text: Then comes Dressrosa, chapter 786, and Luffy's first Gear 4 fight against Doflamingo.

shot.fallback: inflated rubber boy facing a flamboyant pirate

lines.text: And Jesus Burgess shows up, interested in taking the Gomu Gomu fruit off an exhausted Luffy.

shot.fallback: huge pirate looming over a fallen boy

lines.text: Sabo has to step in and stop him, because Luffy can't defend himself.

shot.fallback: masked fighter blocking a huge pirate

lines.text: That's the cost Rayleigh meant: Gear 4 leaves a window.

shot.fallback: boy shrinking after a huge transformation

lines.text: Here's the detail most fans forget. Armament Haki normally stops his rubber from being rubbery.

shot.fallback: boy with a black armored fist

lines.text: Doflamingo points that out, and Gear 4 is the form that gets around it.

shot.fallback: flamboyant pirate pointing at a boy

lines.text: So the warning was about the window right after.

shot.fallback: old man looking at a boy seriously

lines.text: So why would a teacher who sees the bill coming leave Luffy to pay it alone?

shot.fallback: old man leaving a boy on an island

lines.text: Because when Luffy asked how to push Gear 4 further,

shot.fallback: boy asking an old man a question
